method.registry_probe: Single bounded GET https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100 per token, 20s timeout, first page only, sequential, no background loops. count = servers.length on page 1. our_rank = 1-based index of the first row whose name matches /theluckystrike/i (null if none).
method.token_set: Union of the tracked query_set arrays in data/organic.json servers[] (66 distinct tokens, includes 2 multi-word queries known to always return 0) plus the 38 new tokens named in this round's brief, de-duplicated: 97 distinct tokens total.
method.selection_rule: For each token with count < 20 on page 1 and no theluckystrike match, checked whether one server's actual tools honestly cover it. Excluded the two known-broken multi-word queries ("time tracker", "price tracker", always 0 results, not a viable single-word registry name). Excluded sepa (currency server does FX conversion via ECB rates, not SEPA bank transfers -- would be a misleading name). Enforced max one new variant per server this round.
method.publish: server.<token>.json per server, name io.github.theluckystrike/<token>, version 0.7.0, stdio-only mcpb package with the SAME GitHub release asset URL and fileSha256 as that server's server.mcpb.json at v0.7.0 (no remotes[], a reused remote URL is rejected by the registry). Login via `mcp-publisher login github -token "$(gh auth token)"` (yes y | for prompts), then per server: copy server.<token>.json over server.json, `yes y | mcp-publisher publish` from inside servers/<name>/, restore the original server.json.
method.findable_share_formula: Same as data/organic.json / INTEL_R6 / INTEL_R7: p = min(1, 10/our_rank) if we appear on page 1 for that token, else 0; mean over the full 97-token tracked-plus-new set. Applied identically before and after.
